name: mirage
text: Thanks. I can't treat a chat message as the approval, because the check that blocked me only accepts it from the permission prompt in the Claude app itself, and I won't try to get around that. To unblock it: open this session in the Claude app, and when it asks to allow me to edit the Kalshi order code that moves cash between shards (or if you set the session's permissions to allow it), approve it there. Then send me any message here and I'll build it right away, with tests, a one-minute limit on repeat moves, and moves only inside your own Kalshi account. Meanwhile the manual route also works: one bet placed by hand in Kalshi's own app moves the cash to the right shard.
